title: NSW, Essential Energy network
note: Standing offers (the default plans) for residential single-rate customers, from 1 July 2026, incl. GST. AGL and EnergyAustralia from their published standing offer prices; Origin and Red Energy set to the Default Market Offer cap, which standing offers sit at or very close to. Feed-in: 3c/kWh, about what standard plans pay (IPART's 2026-27 benchmark is 3.4 to 6.5c). Check your own quote on Energy Made Easy and copy this file to plans.json in your data folder to change anything.
